_comment: T-306: a sword whose blade is generated per-instance (swingable.bladeGrammar -> blade_iron_straight). Every crafted/spawned copy gets its own item EntityId -> its own seed -> a seed-unique blade shape (length/radius vary within blade_iron_straight's ranges), and the server weapon_trace resolver re-derives the SAME length/radius from that seed so the swing hitbox follows the generated blade. Composed slots let deriveItemStats' _parts path feed off the emitted materials (T-303). Reuses the shared slash/heavy weapon actions -- only the geometry is per-weapon now.
